_comment: Copy to quality.local.json, which Git ignores, then run python scripts/quality_check.py. Every key is optional.
_forbidden_note: Strings that must never appear anywhere in the build, matched literally and ignoring case, in every text file and file name, dot-directories included. A hit is reported by entry number and file, never by its text. Keep this file private: a public fork would publish whatever it lists.
_allowed_note: Deliberate exceptions. Each entry is a regular expression with a nonempty reason. A rule match within 120 characters of an allowed match is accepted, for example a proper noun that uses a British spelling.
_style_note: Writing-style rules, both on by default. em_dash fails em and en dashes; american_spelling fails common British spellings outside URLs. Set either to false to turn it off.
